fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, through the NTRA, launched the eMisr National Broadband Plan on 17 November 2011, a two-phase plan whose first phase is a Framework for Broadband Development and whose second, a Broadband Action Plan, was due in Q2 2012.

The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology's National ICT Strategy 2012-2017 sets out a National Broadband Strategy with targets for 2015, including fixed high-speed coverage of 75% of households at 2 Mbps, 3G for 98% of the population and 13 million high-speed subscribers; the date is the document's published date.
